altText: Navy slide with Educate Me AI logo. Text: Your 2027 GCSE English Language exam dates. AQA, Edexcel, OCR and Eduqas. Save this.
Two date cards: Paper 1, Monday 24 May, morning. Paper 2, Tuesday 8 June, morning. Same dates on all four boards. Some boards call them Component 1 and 2.

How long is each paper? AQA: 1 hour 45 minutes each. OCR: 2 hours each. Edexcel (1EN0): 1 hour 45 minutes, then 2 hours 5 minutes. Eduqas: 1 hour 45 minutes, then 2 hours. Edexcel English Language 2.0: both papers 1 hour 55 minutes, same days.

A simple plan from now to May. 1: Now to Christmas, do one practice Paper 1 and Paper 2 and note which question cost the most marks. 2: January to Easter, one question type a week with feedback from your teacher. 3: Easter to May, timed full papers.

Before each paper. Paper 1 is fiction on AQA, Eduqas and Edexcel (1EN0), and non-fiction on OCR and Edexcel English Language 2.0. Plan your time so the writing section isn’t rushed. Read each question twice and underline what it asks.

posts.title: Helping with mocks, without the nagging
posts.planGate: Metricool Free plan: schedule only after Rej has confirmed the Starter upgrade in chat
altText: Navy slide with Educate Me AI logo. Text: For parents, mocks season. Helping with mocks, without the nagging. A few small things that tend to go down better.

In the run-up. Ask what’s coming up this week, rather than “have you revised?”. Let them choose the plan, and offer to help write it down. Keep evenings normal: meals together, downtime and a sensible bedtime.
Try saying… “What’s your plan for tonight?” instead of “Have you done any revision?”. “What went well?” instead of “What grade did you get?”. Open questions usually get more than a yes or no.

When results come back. Mocks are practice: treat the results as a to-do list, not a verdict. Ask which topics they’d like to go over. Their teacher can usually say which lost marks were about knowledge and which were about exam technique.
Navy end slide with Em’s three circles in green, orange and pink. Text: Save this for mocks week. Share it with another parent. Follow for calm, practical exam-season help.
